dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section towards the posterior, following a consistent, symmetrical parabolic curve until the peduncle terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey baseline; median pixel intensity is significantly lower than mature white but higher than neonatal dark-grey.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-pixel clusters localized primarily around the blowhole and in cloud-like formations along the mid-lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the primary slate-grey canvas and subtle darker mottling regions.
